title: Drainage treatments side by side
process: the same neighbourhood and storms with the pipe network, with a design-standard allowance and no pipes, and with no drainage
executor: node (CPU surface solver) and browser (GPU); raw measurements in street/raw/, scored by run.mjs
equations: no drainage: every drop stays; at rest the pond stands at the level the rain volume fills, V = P A
allowance r (mm/h over the whole area, taken from wet street cells): the most that can stand on the ground at any time is sum over the storm of max(0, i - r) dt x A
geometry: the bowl neighbourhood of PV-SS3 (12,288 m^2)

cases.unit: 60 min nested design storm at a return period (yr); times s; allowance mm/h

solver: FloodSim surface solver with the app's settings (hdry 1e-5 m, hfront 1e-3 m, dtDry 2 s; MUSCL minmod, HLLC, SSP-RK2, CFL 0.48). cpu rows: src/solver-cpu.js (fp64). gpu rows: src/solver-gpu.js in Chrome WebGPU (fp32). Allowance: the app's lumped drainage (src/drainage.js lumpedInfil): 30 mm/h is the app's default, 50 mm/h is the made-up table's 10-yr 60 min depth. Pipes: the PV-SS3 network cases.

reference.independence: arithmetic on the storm and the terrain

outputs: no drainage: pond level at the sag at the end
allowance: the highest volume on the ground against its upper bound
reported for every treatment and storm: peak and end depth at the sag, houses exposed by the wall rule, the volume on the ground at its peak
criteriaNotes: No drainage is arithmetic: 1 cm. The allowance row is one-sided: the peak volume on the ground may not exceed the bound by more than 2 %. The pipe network has no hand answer here; its numbers are reported beside the others.
assumptions: no infiltration other than the allowance
limitations: one made-up neighbourhood in a bowl: every drop that is not drained ends at one sag
which treatment is nearest the truth cannot be read from this case: only the two with hand answers are scored
validRange: the comparison of treatments on this scene
scoring: automated: street/score.mjs builds rows with lib/score.mjs row(); one row set per executor (cpu, gpu), never merged; a case with no raw file is listed as not run and has no rows

criteriaRevisions.why: first registration, before any sandbox case was run
